newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan EPA gives estimate of deregulation effect.
newsitem.headline: Japan EPA gives estimate of deregulation effect.

text.p: Japanese deregulatory measures which took effect in the six years to March 1996 are estimated to have created fresh domestic demand of 7.9 trillion yen a year in nominal terms, the government's Economic Planning Agency said in a report on Friday.

This was equivalent to 1.69 percent of Japan's average annual nominal gross domestic product. Based on the EPA's calculation, deregulatory steps in such areas as telecommunications, distribution, housing and finance created consumer spending worth 5.5 trillion yen and corporate spending worth 2.2 trillion yen per year during the six-year period.
